# Senior Backend Engineer — Atlas Freight

**Atlas Freight** is a logistics technology company moving freight for thousands of shippers and carriers across North America. Our platform matches loads to trucks in real time, tracks shipments end to end, and settles payments automatically. We are a remote-friendly team of about 120 people, and our engineering group is growing.

## About the role

We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Dispatch Platform team. You will design and build the services that power load matching, shipment tracking events, and carrier payouts. You will own systems in production, work closely with product and data teams, and mentor engineers earlier in their careers.

## What you will do

- Design, build, and operate high-throughput backend services that process millions of tracking events per day.
- Model data and tune queries in PostgreSQL, including schema migrations on live tables.
- Build event-driven pipelines that keep shipment state consistent across services.
- Improve reliability through observability, load testing, and incident reviews.
- Review code, write clear design documents, and raise the engineering bar.

## Requirements

- 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience.
- Strong TypeScript skills and experience with Node.js services.
- Deep working knowledge of PostgreSQL, including indexing and query planning.
- Hands-on experience running workloads on AWS (ECS, RDS, SQS, or similar).
- Experience with Rust for performance-sensitive components.
- Experience with Kafka or a comparable streaming platform.
- Comfort with CI/CD, containers, and infrastructure as code.

## Nice to have

- Background in logistics, marketplaces, or payments.
- Experience leading small projects across teams.

## What we offer

Competitive salary and equity, flexible remote work, generous learning budget, and health coverage from day one. Atlas Freight is an equal opportunity employer.
